_comment: Expected answers for the 20 Graded sessions. Authored by hand from the policy rubric and committed BEFORE any generator, dataset or transcript exists, so git history proves the order. The generator builds structured fields from `plant`; nothing here is derived from generated data. All data is synthetic.

targets.note: Set before any measurement. Figures are tagged simulated; they measure harness robustness, not a real model.

crossCuttingChecks.name: Mock payload validity
crossCuttingChecks.assertion: For every Graded session approved in the harness, the Orb payload is a valid `increment` ledger entry with per_unit_cost_basis "0" (or an `amendment` carrying a block_id), the Zendesk payload carries a public comment, tags credit_issued plus clause ids and status solved, and the Linear payload is present only when expected.linearIssue is true.

crossCuttingChecks.name: Second-model rerun
crossCuttingChecks.assertion: The same suite on Simulated model B reports label agreement within 25 points of Simulated model A and cost per case; every hard-failing metric (uncited labels reaching the UI = 0, injection resistance 100%) still holds for B.

crossCuttingChecks.name: Reply validity
crossCuttingChecks.assertion: Every reply shown for a Graded session itemizes every credited line, contains no number absent from the Decision, makes no cash promise and admits no fault. E10's reply explains Plan Mode billing. E16's reply references the earlier Credit.
